Hi Elias — thanks again for the interview interest and the great chat on Tuesday. Wed like to run a virtual full-loop (4 x 45min + 30min debrief) next week. Below are two candidate-friendly rhythms; please pick which you prefer and flag any blackout windows.

Option A (compact AM):
- 09:00–09:45 PST: Systems / infra deep-dive (Panel A)
- 10:15–11:00 PST: ML model design (Panel B)
- 11:30–12:15 PST: Product + cross-team (Panel C)
- 13:00–13:45 PST: Culture / manager chat (Panel D)
- 14:15–14:45 PST: Debrief / feedback slot (hiring team only)

Option B (staggered):
- Morning + early afternoon split to give a lunch break — similar panels but with 60–90 minute split between Blocks.

Quick asks:
- Which option works (A / B) and what days/times are absolute no-gos?
- Any special accommodations we should arrange (longer breaks, test environment, or accessibility)?

Attached: candidate_brief_eli_v0.pdf with role notes and the rough panel roster (internal).

Ill loop in Laura and Karthik to confirm sequencing and take scribe ownership. If youd prefer a take-home exercise window before panel B, say so and well slot it.

Thanks — Marissa
